name: pipe-editor
description: Local CI studio for discovering, editing, validating and exporting portable pipelines.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend run build && pnpm --dir frontend run build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend test && pnpm --dir frontend test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend run typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend run typecheck
scripts.install:all: pnpm --dir backend install && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend run lint && pnpm --dir frontend run lint
